title: A line added from ShopCoach keeps the title and description the builder showed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an open work order for this test, work order 1, for an asset with its year, make and model filled in, so ShopCoach can suggest lines for it.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type "brakes grinding" in the ShopCoach Line Builder box on work order 1's Lines tab.
  2. Click Build Lines.
  3. Click the add button of the first suggested line.
  4. Click the added line's title on work order 1's Lines tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "brakes grinding" shows in the ShopCoach Line Builder box of work order 1.

Step 2:

  • Suggested lines appear in a table, each with a title and a description.
  • Keep the first suggested line's title and description in view; step 4 compares them.

Step 3:

  • The first suggested line is added to work order 1 and is listed on its Lines tab with the same title and description as in the table.

Step 4:

  • The Edit Line window opens.
  • Title and Description read exactly the title and description the builder showed in step 2: nothing added, cut or reworded.
  • Neither value contains "What are you doing?" or "Why are you doing it?".

What you should see today: after you click Build Lines, nothing appears: no suggested lines, no error message, and the builder never shows that it has finished (seen on staging; whether the QA build sv10130 has the same fault is not known). This is a known problem and it is already reported — see https://shopview.atlassian.net/browse/SV-11850 (found on staging on 27 Oct 2026).

· If you see exactly that, mark this test FAILED and do not raise anything new.

· If it fails in a DIFFERENT way from what is described above, that is a NEW problem — please report it.

· If it PASSES, the fix has shipped: report it so the ticket can be closed and this note removed.
